name: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
summary: Athens university founded in 1837; three fee-paying English-taught degrees: Medicine, Pharmacy and ancient Greece archaeology, history and literature.

ib.text: The English-taught degrees take the IB Diploma directly. Medicine and Pharmacy ask 36 points with three HL subjects, two of them Physics, Chemistry or Biology; the BA asks an indicative 70% average.

lastYear.text: BA 1 Aug; MD 18 Dec–30 Apr; Pharmacy rolling

apply.via: Each programme's own online application platform

programmes.name: Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece
programmes.about: Greek antiquity through archaeology, ancient history and Greek and Latin literature, taught in English in Athens with classes at museums and archaeological sites and field trips (240 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Open to international applicants with the IB Diploma (indicative 70% average or equivalent); English proof: TOEFL 88, IELTS 6.5 or FCE B2, unless a native speaker.

programmes.name: Medicine (English-taught Medical Degree)
programmes.about: Six-year medical degree in English: five pre-clinical semesters, clinical courses, then full-time clinical practice in university departments at 16 Athens hospitals (360 ECTS).
programmes.ib: IB 36 points with three HL subjects, two from Physics, Chemistry and Biology, or another accepted qualification; English proof; motivation letter; online interview.

needs.note: Two of the three at HL, inside three HL subjects in total

programmes.selectionNote: Predicted IB grades are accepted for final-year students; an invited applicant has an online interview. A deposit secures the place. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Integrated Master in Pharmacy (MPharm)
programmes.about: Five-year integrated master's in Pharmacy taught in English for international students: eight semesters of theory and laboratory courses, then a practice and thesis year (300 ECTS).
programmes.ib: IB 36 points with three HL subjects, two from Physics, Chemistry and Biology, or another accepted qualification; English proof; motivation letter; interview.

needs.note: Two of the three at HL, inside three HL subjects in total

programmes.selectionNote: Applications are processed on a rolling basis, so apply early; predicted IB grades are accepted. An eligible applicant may be interviewed online. 2026 criteria.

notes: Medicine and Pharmacy are addressed exclusively to foreign nationals who attended their last two school years outside Greece; the BA is open to international applicants.
Medicine and Pharmacy take a non-refundable deposit on acceptance (€5,000 and €3,000), deducted from the first-year fee; EU and non-EU citizens pay the same fee.
Greek-taught NKUA degrees are entered through the Ministry of Education's foreign-school graduates category, not through these programme applications.
